255982651_281f85a8.text: The ability to modulate the flow of information is supported by a second abundant neuronal type, the inhibitory GABA neurons of the reticular nucleus of the thalamus (TRN). TRN neurons are defined by the expression of the parvalbumin gene (Biasi et al., 1994), their fast spiking action and specific connectivity, which is strictly confined within the thalamus. 255982651_5ff436ed.text: The TRN neurons derive from GABAergic progenitors in the embryonic prethalamic (pTh) compartment (Cobos et al., 2005).
